objective_for_doctor:
Age: 35
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: purulent nasal discharge

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I have greenish or yellowish nasal discharge and a cough. I also have pain with a burning or sharp quality in my forehead, left cheek, nose, left eye, and right temple, which radiates to the back of my head.
1) How long have you had the nasal discharge and cough (days/weeks)?
I don’t know. I’ve had a cold in the last 2 weeks, though.
2) Do you have fever or chills, and if so what’s the highest temperature you’ve measured?
I don’t know. I’ve had a cold in the last 2 weeks.
3) Is the facial pain/pressure worse when you bend forward or when you press over your sinuses (forehead/cheek)?
I don’t know.
4) Do you have any eye symptoms—redness, pain with eye movement, or vision changes?
I don’t know. I do have pain in my left eye.
5) Is the left eye pain associated with redness or swelling around the eye (eyelid swelling), or is it mainly “behind” the eye?
I don’t know. I have pain in my left eye.
6) Any severe headache or “worst headache,” neck stiffness, or light sensitivity?
I don’t know. I do have pain with a burning or sharp quality in my forehead, left cheek, nose, left eye, and right temple, which radiates to the back of my head.
7) Do you have any shortness of breath, wheezing, or chest pain?
I don’t know. I have asthma or have used a bronchodilator in the past.
8) During this illness, have you had increased wheezing or need for your bronchodilator more than usual?
I don’t know. I have asthma or have used a bronchodilator in the past.
9) Are you currently having any wheezing or trouble breathing right now?
I don’t know. I have asthma or have used a bronchodilator in the past.
10) Do you have any history of allergies (seasonal allergies) and do symptoms flare with exposure (pollen, pets, dust)?
Yes. I’m more likely to develop common allergies than the general population.
11) Do you have itching of the eyes/nose, sneezing, or watery discharge more than thick green/yellow mucus?
I don’t know. I do have greenish or yellowish nasal discharge and a cough.
12) Have you had any dental pain (upper teeth) or bad-smelling nasal discharge on one side?

I don’t know. I’ve had greenish or yellowish nasal discharge and a cough. I also have pain that’s burning or sharp in my forehead, left cheek, nose, left eye, and right temple, radiating to the back of my head.
13) Is the facial pain mainly on one side (left) or truly both sides?
It’s on the left side—forehead, left cheek, left eye, and nose—with the pain also in the right temple. It radiates to the back of my head.
14) Any rash, hives, lip/tongue swelling, or trouble swallowing?
I don’t know.
[DDX] Acute rhinosinusitis, Allergic sinusitis, Viral pharyngitis, Pneumonia, Acute COPD exacerbation / infection
